model: NanoWizard 4 XP BioScience AFM + Olympus IX73 (parked head configuration)

dimension_evidence.uncertainty: Whole assembly inferred by anchoring Olympus IX73 frame to manufacturer 323x475x721mm, then adding photographed vibration base and parked AFM head to the right. +/-15% complete assembly; host itself is manufacturer-documented. NanoWizard head scale also constrained by published 140mm free sample volume. Not a manufacturer specification for the combined workstation.

author: Virtual Lab project / Codex
notes: Exact publicly licensed source mesh not found; project-authored geometry from model-specific photographs and literature.

Scope and dimension uncertainty are recorded in dimension_evidence.
component_scope: Olympus IX73 host frame and NanoWizard 4 XP head in photographed parked service pose; excludes computer and separate control electronics
dimensional_use: approximate visualization only; not mechanical CAD
axis: X right, Y back, Z up in Blender; standard Y-up glTF export

review.reviewer: Primary agent visual QA, actual final pipeline renders
